settings.heading: Order Prep Associate / Golf Club Builder
settings.sub_head:
Haywood Golf
📍 Vancouver, BC
⏱ 32 hours per week

Overview

Haywood Golf is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Golf Club Builder / Order Prep Associate to join our operations team. This is a hands-on role focused on ensuring every custom-built club meets our quality standards before reaching the customer.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Order preparation and packing of custom golf clubs
  • Cleaning and finishing clubs prior to shipment
  • Quality control checks on completed builds
  • Organizing inventory and maintaining a clean work area
  • Assisting with basic club builds (training provided)

Role Scope

  • Initial focus on order prep, packing, and cleaning
  • Responsibilities may expand to include assisting with club builds as skills develop

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong attention to detail
  • Reliable and punctual
  • Comfortable with hands-on, repetitive tasks
  • Interest in golf or golf equipment (preferred, not required)
  • Willingness to learn club-building processes

Schedule & Compensation

  • 32 hours per week
  • Competitive hourly wage (based on experience)

What We Offer

  • Employee discount on Haywood Golf clubs after a 3-month probation period
  • Occasional team lunches
  • Periodic team golf rounds and outings + weekly simulator golf challenges
  • A relaxed, respectful, and detail-driven work environment


How to Apply

Email your resume to:

📧 info@haywoodgolf.com
